title: Java Edition is moving house
translated_title: Java版即将迁移新的服务器或平台。
author: Staff
description: Same Minecraft, new and improved account!

blocks.source_text: We know change can be inconvenient. Just ask us what happened when the office ran out of our regular coffee beans for one day. Actually, it’s better if you don’t. Let’s talk about another Java altogether.
blocks.translated_text: 我们知道变化可能会带来不便。问问我们就知道，有一次办公室的普通咖啡豆用完了会怎么样吧……实际上，你最好别知道真相。我们还是聊聊 Java 版的其他内容吧。

blocks.source_text: Change can also pave the way for a better future. That’s why we’ve decided that moving forward, all of our games will require a Microsoft account to play – including Minecraft Java Edition. Why? Think of it as moving house; when you outgrow one place, you move on to the next. It involves a logistic effort, but once you’re settled in your new home, you realize you’d do it ten times over just for that extra room. Except in our case, the extra room is all of these features, from which all Microsoft accounts will benefit:
blocks.translated_text: 变化也能为更美好的未来铺平道路。因此，我们决定从现在开始，所有游戏都需要使用 Microsoft 账户才能玩——包括 Minecraft Java 版。为什么呢？可以把它想象成搬家：当你觉得某个地方不再适合你时，就会搬到另一个地方。虽然需要做一些准备工作，但一旦你在新家安顿下来，你会发现，即使要多花十倍的成本，也愿意这么做，只为了那多出来的空间。只不过在我们的情况下，这个“多出来的空间”就是所有这些新功能，所有 Microsoft 账户都能从中受益。”

blocks.source_text: Increased security for your account with two-factor authentication. In other words, it’s harder for someone to access your account without your permission.
blocks.translated_text: 通过双因素认证提升你的账户安全性。换句话说，未经你的允许，别人很难访问你的账户了。——译者注：这里的“two-factor authentication”保留了英文缩写形式，以符合游戏官方的表述习惯

blocks.source_text: All your PC Minecraft games will be connected to the same account. Currently, that’s Minecraft and Minecraft Dungeons, but who knows what we'll do next?
blocks.translated_text: 你所有的 PC 版 Minecraft 游戏都将连接到同一个账号。目前这个账号可以用于 Minecraft 和我的世界：地下城（Minecraft Dungeons），但谁知道我们未来会做出什么改变呢？

blocks.source_text: Improved parental controls to help keep kids safe when playing online.
blocks.translated_text: 优化了家长控制功能，帮助保护孩子在线游戏时的安全。
新增了聊天和邀请阻止功能。

blocks.source_text: Now just to be clear, migrating from Mojang to Microsoft accounts is *mandatory*. If you don’t make the move, in several months you won’t be able to log in anymore – which means you won’t be able to play either. But no need to worry, because we’ll give you detailed and clear instructions on how to do so. You’ll get the information you need through this site, [an FAQ on our support page](https://help.minecraft.net/hc/en-us/articles/360050865492), videos on our YouTube channel, and even emails straight to your inbox.
blocks.translated_text: 需要明确的是，从 Mojang 账号迁移到 Microsoft 账号是*强制性的*。如果你不完成迁移，几个月后你就将无法登录游戏了——也就是说，你就不能再玩了。不过不用担心，我们会提供详细且明确的迁移指南。你可以通过这个网站、[我们的支持页面上的 FAQ](https://help.minecraft.net/hc/en-us/articles/360050865492)、YouTube 频道上的视频，甚至直接发送到你邮箱的邮件来获取所需的信息。

blocks.source_text: After you’ve moved, everything you love about Java will still be there. You’ll still be able to create and use mods and skins (while keeping your existing ones, of course), as well as play with friends on Java servers (regardless of version). You’ll also keep your Minecraft Java username, and new players will still get to choose their Minecraft username. The only difference? You’ll receive a cool reward once you’ve logged in with your Microsoft account:** a special cape!** This way, everyone will know that you were there for the big move *and* that you have an impeccable sense of fashion. And who knows? You might even have more than one outfit to show off – but we’ll tell you more about that later down the road.
blocks.translated_text: 迁移后，你喜欢 Java 版游戏的方方面面都不会改变。你仍然可以创建和使用模组和皮肤（当然也可以保留现有的那些），还可以在 Java 版服务器上与朋友一起玩耍（无论使用哪个版本）。你的 Minecraft Java 用户名也会保留下来，新玩家也可以自行选择他们的 Minecraft 用户名。唯一的区别是：当你使用 Microsoft 账户登录后，会收到一份超棒的奖励——一件特别设计的斗篷！这样一来，每个人都会知道你参与了这次重大转变，同时也会看出你的时尚品味。谁知道呢？你甚至可能有多套服装可以展示呢——不过关于这一点，我们会稍后详细告诉你。

blocks.source_text: In case you’re skimming through this post looking for something informative *and* entertaining, here it is! Our own Nathan “Dinnerbone” Adams held a special presentation on what this transition means for Java players. How special? For starters, he’s actually standing upright this time, but I’ll let you discover the rest for yourself:
blocks.translated_text: 如果你正在快速浏览这篇帖子，希望找到既有信息又有娱乐性的内容，那么它就在这里！我们的 Nathan “Dinnerbone” Adams 举办了一场特别的演讲，讲述了这次转型对 Java 版玩家的意味着什么。这次演讲有什么特别之处呢？首先，他这次竟然能够直立站立了！但其余的内容就留给你们自己去发现了吧。

blocks.source_text: So when will this transition happen? If you already have Java or a Mojang account, you will have to start moving accounts in early 2021. New players who are getting Java for the first time will create Microsoft accounts rather than Mojang accounts starting this fall. How will it go down? Here is an overview of the process:
blocks.translated_text: 那么这次转型具体什么时候会发生呢？如果你已经拥有 Java 版或 Mojang 账号，就需要在 2021 年初开始迁移账号了。而首次使用 Java 版的新玩家则将从今年秋天开始创建 Microsoft 账号，而不是 Mojang 账号。具体流程是怎样的呢？这里有一个概述。

blocks.source_text: Since we have a large Java player community, we’ll need to move players to Microsoft accounts in batches. But everyone will get moved, and you’ll get an opportunity to participate and receive your cape! Or is that capes? Hmm.
blocks.translated_text: 由于我们拥有大量的 Java 版玩家社区，因此我们需要分批次将玩家迁移到 Microsoft 账号。不过每个人都会被迁移，而且你们还将有机会参与这次迁移过程，并获得属于自己的“斗篷”！或者应该是“披风”吧？嗯……

blocks.source_text: You’ll get an email that will include instructions on how to move your account. We won’t send the email to everyone at the same time – so don’t panic if your friend got it and you didn’t. Everyone will get their turn.
blocks.translated_text: 您会收到一封电子邮件，其中包含关于如何转移账户的说明。我们不会同时给所有人发送邮件——所以如果您的朋友收到了而您没有收到，请不要慌张。每个人都会依次收到。

blocks.source_text: Once you have completed the steps, you’ll use your Microsoft account to log in to Minecraft going forward. You’ll no longer be able to log in using your Mojang account.
blocks.translated_text: 完成这些步骤后，您将使用您的 Microsoft 账户登录 Minecraft。您将无法再使用 Mojang 账户登录了。

blocks.source_text: You’ll receive your cape as our way of thanking you for the effort.
blocks.translated_text: 作为对您努力的感谢，您将收到一件披风。

blocks.source_text: This might be a bit much to take in all at once, which is why we went through the trouble of putting together a (bad) haiku to sum up all the benefits:
blocks.translated_text: 这一切可能有点难以立刻理解，因此我们费心创作了一首（不太好的）俳句来总结所有好处。
*所有游戏都集中在一个账户下，*
*同样的 Java 游戏引擎，外加一件披风。*

blocks.source_text: So if you find yourself feeling like this transition is a hassle (but let’s be honest, it really isn’t – and that’s coming from a group of people who have had structured debates over who should order lunch), recite this short poem to get through. You’ll be back to mining, crafting, and modding in no time.
blocks.translated_text: 如果你觉得这个过渡过程很麻烦（但说实话，其实并没有那么麻烦——这话可是来自一群曾经为“谁该负责点午餐”而进行过认真讨论的人啊），那就背诵这首小诗吧。很快你就会重新投入到挖掘、制作和模组制作中去了。

content:
We know change can be inconvenient. Just ask us what happened when the office ran out of our regular coffee beans for one day. Actually, it’s better if you don’t. Let’s talk about another Java altogether.

Change can also pave the way for a better future. That’s why we’ve decided that moving forward, all of our games will require a Microsoft account to play – including Minecraft Java Edition. Why? Think of it as moving house; when you outgrow one place, you move on to the next. It involves a logistic effort, but once you’re settled in your new home, you realize you’d do it ten times over just for that extra room. Except in our case, the extra room is all of these features, from which all Microsoft accounts will benefit:

Increased security for your account with two-factor authentication. In other words, it’s harder for someone to access your account without your permission.

All your PC Minecraft games will be connected to the same account. Currently, that’s Minecraft and Minecraft Dungeons, but who knows what we'll do next?

Improved parental controls to help keep kids safe when playing online.

Chat and invitation blocking.

Now just to be clear, migrating from Mojang to Microsoft accounts is *mandatory*. If you don’t make the move, in several months you won’t be able to log in anymore – which means you won’t be able to play either. But no need to worry, because we’ll give you detailed and clear instructions on how to do so. You’ll get the information you need through this site, [an FAQ on our support page](https://help.minecraft.net/hc/en-us/articles/360050865492), videos on our YouTube channel, and even emails straight to your inbox.

[IMAGE](https://www.minecraft.net/content/dam/minecraftnet/games/minecraft/game-characters/OneDesktop-Mod.png)

After you’ve moved, everything you love about Java will still be there. You’ll still be able to create and use mods and skins (while keeping your existing ones, of course), as well as play with friends on Java servers (regardless of version). You’ll also keep your Minecraft Java username, and new players will still get to choose their Minecraft username. The only difference? You’ll receive a cool reward once you’ve logged in with your Microsoft account:** a special cape!** This way, everyone will know that you were there for the big move *and* that you have an impeccable sense of fashion. And who knows? You might even have more than one outfit to show off – but we’ll tell you more about that later down the road.

In case you’re skimming through this post looking for something informative *and* entertaining, here it is! Our own Nathan “Dinnerbone” Adams held a special presentation on what this transition means for Java players. How special? For starters, he’s actually standing upright this time, but I’ll let you discover the rest for yourself:

[IMAGE](https://www.minecraft.net/content/dam/minecraftnet/games/minecraft/key-art/OneDesktop-YTthumbnail.jpg)

So when will this transition happen? If you already have Java or a Mojang account, you will have to start moving accounts in early 2021. New players who are getting Java for the first time will create Microsoft accounts rather than Mojang accounts starting this fall. How will it go down? Here is an overview of the process:

Since we have a large Java player community, we’ll need to move players to Microsoft accounts in batches. But everyone will get moved, and you’ll get an opportunity to participate and receive your cape! Or is that capes? Hmm.

You’ll get an email that will include instructions on how to move your account. We won’t send the email to everyone at the same time – so don’t panic if your friend got it and you didn’t. Everyone will get their turn.

Once you have completed the steps, you’ll use your Microsoft account to log in to Minecraft going forward. You’ll no longer be able to log in using your Mojang account.

You’ll receive your cape as our way of thanking you for the effort.

[IMAGE](https://www.minecraft.net/content/dam/minecraftnet/games/minecraft/game-characters/OneDesktop-Cape.png)

This might be a bit much to take in all at once, which is why we went through the trouble of putting together a (bad) haiku to sum up all the benefits:

*Great security, *

*All games under one account, *

*Same Java, with cape. *

So if you find yourself feeling like this transition is a hassle (but let’s be honest, it really isn’t – and that’s coming from a group of people who have had structured debates over who should order lunch), recite this short poem to get through. You’ll be back to mining, crafting, and modding in no time.
